prompt_text: What are the best vacation rentals in Santa Cruz County California and how do I pick one?
answer_verbatim:
# Finding Vacation Rentals in Santa Cruz County

## Popular Platforms
- **Airbnb** - largest selection, user reviews
- **VRBO** - often owner-direct, good for houses
- **Booking.com** - competitive pricing
- **Local sites** - Santa Cruz County tourism board website

## Key Areas to Consider
- **Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk** - touristy, walkable, lively
- **Capitola** - charming village, artsy vibe
- **Aptos/Seacliff** - quieter, family-friendly
- **Scotts Valley** - inland, near redwoods
- **Watsonville** - budget-friendly, agricultural area

## How to Pick One

**Define your priorities:**
- Budget range
- Beach access vs. quiet retreat
- Amenities (kitchen, hot tub, parking)
- Group size and layout needs

**Check reviews carefully:**
- Read recent reviews (last 3-6 months)
- Look for comments on cleanliness, accuracy, host responsiveness
- Note any recurring complaints

**Verify details:**
- Confirm parking situation (crucial in Santa Cruz)
- Check cancellation policy
- Ask about hidden fees
- Confirm pet policies if needed

**Red flags:**
- No recent reviews
- Vague photos
- Unclear pricing breakdown
- Unresponsive hosts

**Pro tip:** Visit in shoulder seasons (spring/fall) for better prices and fewer crowds.

What type of experience are you looking for?
